text:
Priya (Marketing): Quick kickoff: we need a compact battlecard for the webinar follow-up + routing rules so high-intent, high-cost-probability leads land with AEs. Aim: one-pager AE card, 2-line SDR scripts, and HubSpot routing map.
Diego (Product): For the battlecard, highlight three measurable differentiators: 1) predictable p95 under load, 2) deployment parity (hosted/dedicated/private), 3) cost controls via batching & cache. I'll export a simple perf CSV for the slides.
Noah (Sales): SDR script idea (super short):
- Opening: "Are you optimizing inference cost or just model cost?"
- Objection steer: "If infra ops is a concern, Redwood handles it across environments."
I'll make 2 variants (startup vs enterprise).
Talia (Growth): Routing logic proposal for landing form, keep it simple to start:
```
if (form.expected_monthly_tokens >= 1e9 || company.employee_count >= 1000) route = 'enterprise-priority';
else if (form.role == 'engineer' && form.use_case == 'proof-of-concept') route = 'webinar-or-demo';
else route = 'nurture-marketing';
```
We can add a hidden field to capture estimated token burn.
mkt-bot: Note: webinar asset folder created: https://drive.redwood/webinar-assets/launch-2025. Demo infra scheduled Fri 09:30 PDT.
Priya (Marketing): Webinar flow: 5m market setup, 10m latency/cost benchmark narrative (customer example), 15m live demo (fallbacks + dedicated failover), 5m Q&A. Need 2 slide versions: technical & business.
Diego (Product): Bench plan: compare ModelA on GCP managed endpoint, ModelA on self-hosted infra (raw), ModelA on Redwood-hosted + Dedicated. Table fields: env, seq_len, p95_ms, tokens_per_usd. I'll annotate config (quant+batch).
Noah (Sales): AE one-liners for slide deck (choose one):
- "Redwood: serving primitives so your product's latency and cost don't surprise you."
- "Not just models — predictable serving at scale."
Feedback?
Talia (Growth): Landing CTA experiments: 1) "Join webinar" vs 2) "Request enterprise demo". We'll A/B by referral source. Also add dynamic routing rule for high token estimates -> AE.
Priya (Marketing): Deliverables & owners: battlecard draft (Diego), SDR cheats (Noah), HubSpot routing + hidden field (Talia), slides + script (Priya). Deadline: Monday noon for drafts.
Diego (Product): I'll include 2 short caveats in the battlecard: (a) microbench depends on seq len & batch profile; (b) quantization may change quality tradeoffs.
Noah (Sales): I'll prepare 3 procurement-ready bullets: pricing model (usage + reserved), SLA overview, and data residency options. Keep them <3 lines each.
Talia (Growth): I'll set up routing rules in a test pipeline and share the mapping doc. Plan: roll to prod after Wednesday demo.
Priya (Marketing): Great. Also add a single-sentence competitive angle vs managed cloud APIs: "Managed cloud endpoints get you a model quickly; Redwood gets you predictable serving for production." Keep it tight.
Diego (Product): Uploading perf CSVs to the doc now. Will call out the exact hardware used.
Priya (Marketing): Thanks team. I'll post the draft battlecard here when ready. :sparkles:
